reconciliation.description: Load ledger rows from the account opening, mark what cleared, and keep the book-versus-statement difference visible.

imprest.title: Imprest

hints.features: Features switched on for a branch.
hints.secondLevel: An extra lock for sensitive actions.
hints.retention: How long the trail is kept.

sidebar.title: CSSD
sidebar.subtitle: Sterile supply
sidebar.emptyGroup: No screens in this group yet.

hub.title: CSSD
hub.subtitle: Central sterile supply. Masters and the sterilization loop live here; linen stays with Linen.
hub.emptyGroup: No screens in this group yet.

masters.autoclaveHint: The sterilizer. Its number is stored in upper case and must be unique.
masters.cycleHint: The sterilization method used when a cycle is recorded.
masters.packingHint: How a set or item is packed on a sterile request.
masters.indicatorHint: The kind of quality check. Test names belong to an indicator type.
masters.testHint: A check that belongs to an indicator type. Result types belong to a test name.
masters.resultHint: A possible result of a test name. Inactive entries stay off new documents.
masters.inactiveHint: An inactive master is hidden when a new document asks for one.
masters.errInactiveParent: That master is inactive. Choose an active one.
masters.errRequired: Number or code, and name, are required.

sets.title: Set
sets.description: A named tray of items or child sets. Saving also creates the inventory kit for this set.
sets.dialogDescription: The code is generated. At least one item or child set is required. A set cannot contain itself.
sets.created: Set saved. Its inventory kit was created.
sets.errLines: Add at least one item or child set.
sets.errTwice: That line is already on the set.
sets.errKitForm: The kit form is not set up. Add the drug form KIT before saving a set.
sets.errKitCategory: The item category is not set up. Add the category KITS before saving a set.
sets.errItem: That item is not in inventory.
sets.errChild: That child set was not found.

requests.title: Sterile Request
requests.description: A ward or theatre asks CSSD to sterilize sets and loose items. Stock moves only when the request is approved.
requests.formHint: The sterilizing store and the transit store are required before sending. Each line needs a packing type. Sending gives each line a packing number.
requests.sent: Sent for approval. Packing numbers were created.
requests.approved: Approved. Items moved to the transit store and sets were booked there, unsterile.
requests.serials: Serial numbers, one per line. The count must equal the quantity.
requests.errStores: The sterilizing store and the transit store are required before sending.
requests.errTransit: The transit store is not the requesting store.
requests.errLines: Add at least one set or item.
requests.errPacking: Each line needs an active packing type.
requests.errSerial: The serial count must equal the quantity.
requests.errBatch: Batch quantities must equal the line quantity.
requests.errStock: Not enough stock in the requesting store.
requests.errItem: That item is not in inventory.
requests.errSet: That set is inactive or unknown.
requests.errTwice: That item is already on the request.

receipts.title: Unsterile Receipt
receipts.description: Receive sets and items from an approved sterile request. Stock moves from the transit store to the CSSD store only when this receipt is approved, and it stays unsterile.
receipts.formHint: Convert from an approved sterile request. Received quantity can be zero up to the quantity still open. Save, send for approval, then approve.
receipts.pickSource: Select the sterile request to convert.
receipts.sent: Sent for approval. Stock has not moved.
receipts.approved: Approved. Items and sets moved to the CSSD store, still unsterile.
receipts.cancelled: Cancelled. An approved receipt puts the request back open for receipt.
receipts.errConvert: please select the document to convert.
receipts.errSameStore: The CSSD store is not the transit store.
receipts.errOpen: Received quantity is above the quantity still open.
receipts.errLines: Receive at least one set or item.
receipts.errStock: Not enough stock in the transit store.

issues.title: Sterile Issue
issues.description: Issue sterile sets and items from an approved request, or issue them directly. Stock moves to the transit store only when this document is approved.
issues.formHint: Convert from a sterile request and pick packing numbers or sterile batches that add up to the line quantity. A quantity of zero leaves that line off the document. Expired sterile stock stays where it is.
issues.pickSource: Select the sterile request to convert.
issues.sent: Sent for approval. Stock has not moved.
issues.approved: Approved. Sets and items moved to the transit store.
issues.cancelled: Cancelled. An approved issue returns the stock.
issues.errConvert: please select the document to convert.
issues.errSum: picks must add up to the line quantity
issues.errPack: a pick is above the stock of that pack
issues.errBatch: a pick is above the stock of that batch
issues.errExpired: expired sterile stock cannot be issued
issues.errDirect: a direct issue cannot post set stock
issues.errOpen: issued quantity is above the quantity still open
issues.errLines: issue at least one set or item
issues.errSame: the issue store is not the transit store

ward.title: Sterile Receipt
ward.description: The ward receives a sterile issue. Stock moves from the transit store to the requesting store only when this receipt is approved, and the pack is sterile at the ward.
ward.formHint: Convert from an approved sterile issue, including a direct issue. Save, send for approval, then approve. Cancel of an approved receipt sets that issue back to pending.
ward.pickSource: Select the sterile issue to convert.
ward.sent: Sent for approval. Stock has not moved.
ward.approved: Approved. Sets and items are sterile at the ward.
ward.cancelled: Cancelled. The sterile issue is pending again.
ward.errConvert: please select the document to convert.
ward.errWaiting: This issue is not waiting to be received.
ward.errSame: The transit store is not the receipt store.

trace.title: Pack Trace
trace.description: A packing number shows the request, the cycle that sterilized it, and the store that holds it now.
trace.missing: That packing number was not found.
trace.noQc: No quality checks on this cycle.

cycles.title: Sterilization Cycle
cycles.description: A load in an autoclave. Stock becomes sterile in this branch's sterile store only when every quality check passes and the cycle is approved.
cycles.formHint: Save records the load. Approve needs a passing quality check. A failed load can start the next cycle number. An approved load cannot be run again.
cycles.approved: Approved. The load is sterile stock in this branch.
cycles.repeated: The next cycle number is ready.
cycles.storeSaved: Sterile store saved for this branch.
cycles.errExpiry: Expiry must be after the sterilization date.
cycles.errLines: Add at least one set or item.
cycles.errQc: Approve needs at least one quality check.
cycles.errFail: A failed result cannot be approved. The load stays unsterile.
cycles.errApproved: An already approved load cannot be run again.
cycles.errLatest: Only the latest cycle of a load can start the next cycle number.
cycles.errBowie: The first cycle of this autoclave today needs a passed Bowie Dick test.
cycles.errStore: The sterile store is not set for this branch.
cycles.errBranch: Choose a branch. The sterile store is read for that branch.
cycles.errPack: That packing number is not an unsterile set.

bowie.title: Bowie Dick
bowie.description: The daily test of an autoclave. The first cycle of that autoclave on a calendar day waits for a passed test.
bowie.errFail: A failed test needs the measure of failure.

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.description: Each hospital keeps its edition. Extra SKUs turn on without a redeploy.
tenants.invalid: That SKU set is missing a dependency.
tenants.unhealthy: The module did not pass its health check, so it stays off.

entitlements.title: Entitlements
entitlements.description: Grant or revoke SKUs. A module stays off until its schema and health check pass.
entitlements.dialogDescription: The registry checks the dependency closure, then activates each new SKU.

desk.name: Name
desk.noStock: A service receipt does not add stock.

desk.name: Name / destination
desk.hint: Tax and discount stay on the cashier. Sponsor and BPJS claims stay on the cashier insurance panel.

payrollDesk.title: Payroll desk
payrollDesk.hint: The payslip stays on this screen. Nothing is emailed.
